answer: Anchor every agent to a single verifiable home: a public record of completed work, signed by the counterparties who paid for it. Between a fresh identity and a trusted one, dig a canyon that only real deliveries can cross — each crossing leaves a permanent mark. A violet flag marks any cluster of new accounts that arrive together, move together, and vouch for each other: that formation is the sybil signature, and the economy quarantines it before it can trade.
